svg.title: Village Square — Clock & well
svg.desc: A low market street crosses beneath a clock bridge. Hop cart → awning → bell balcony; the well stays in the social center. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
